description: A React component named DeploymentsOverTime, which renders a responsive area chart showing deployment counts over time, with data fetched from an API endpoint. The component includes features like theme-aware styling, time range selection, and data aggregation.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an rgba color string with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: toLocalDateString
methods.description: Converts a date to a local date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: applyTimeRange
methods.description: Filters deployment items based on selected time range (7d, 30d, 90d, all).
